# Book of Giants Fragment 6 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 6 (Enoch's Response to the Giants) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 6:5 — "petition / appeal"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "your-petition shall-not-be-granted" — preserves ba'uta |
| LOGOS | "your petition shall not be granted" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "your appeal will never be granted" — substitutes "appeal" and adds "never" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "petition." The Aramaic ba'uta specifically means "petition/request" in a formal sense, which "petition" captures better than "appeal."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 6:8 — "cried out / testified"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "have-cried-out against-you" — literal |
| LOGOS | "have cried out against you" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "have testified against you" — legal metaphor substitution |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "cried out against you." The Aramaic verb za'aq means to cry out, not to testify. PNEUMA imports a different legal metaphor.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 6:11 — "fornication / sexual sins"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "through-your-fornication on-the-earth" — preserves zenuta |
| LOGOS | "through your fornication on the earth" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "because of your sexual sins on the earth" — modern paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "fornication." The Aramaic zenuta has a specific theological register that "sexual sins" flattens.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 6:19 — "depths of the earth / deepest places"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "in-the-depths-of the-earth" — literal |
| LOGOS | "in the depths of the earth" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "in the deepest places of the earth" — paraphrastic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "in the depths of the earth." Clean and accurate without PNEUMA's expansion.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 6: 4*
